author.description: @WhiteHouse Deputy Chief of Staff for Policy and Homeland Security Advisor | 45 & 47

tweets.text:
The main domestic issues that animated the campaign were taking back America’s culture and sanity (understanding almost everything else is downstream). Banishing DEI and leftwing race bigotry. Stopping trans and gender madness. Halting hostile migration. Implementing mass deportation. Restoring merit and excellence. Imposing order and safety to our cities. Crushing woke ideology. Defeating indoctrination in our schools. Defending Western Civilization. Reversing the communist takeover of our institutions. Dethroning the Deep State. Halting censorship. Reawakening national pride. Imposing democratic control over the bureaucracy. Ending weaponized government while ensuring accountability for the corrupt and the criminal. Creating a government that serves and honors its hardworking citizens as its unbreakable moral duty.

Beginning with astonishing speed on January 20th, President Trump has been delivering on each and every one of these promises with unyielding determination—starting with the historic and unprecedented slate of Day One Executive Orders.

The reconciliation bill is the essential, critical vehicle to achieve the liberation Trump vowed in his inaugural, and to unlock the Golden Age for all Americans.

Some now are trying to read their own priorities — many of which are important, many of which are valid — into the 2024 election. They are trying to rewrite the history, really, of the last ten years.

Now is not the time to rewrite history. Now is the time to make history by fulfilling the hopes and dreams of the nation after the long and righteous struggle that has delivered MAGA to the mountaintop.
